_comment: Settings for the VPS host tooling. Read at run time by host-setup.mjs and skillhost,
so changing something here needs no code edit. Delete a key to take its default.
workspaceRoot   where clones live. One directory per repo.
stem            the one name used for the command and for the systemd units, so
`systemctl --user status <stem>-session@<id>` is always guessable from
the command you typed.
permissionMode  how sessions run. 'auto' is full auto mode WITHOUT the dangerous skip flag.
capacity        how many sessions may run at once on this whole box. 'auto' works it
out from this box's RAM. A number overrides that.
perSessionMb    the memory a session is assumed to want, used by the 'auto' calculation.
allowedHosts    git hosts a clone may come from. Nothing else is accepted, whoever asks.
bind / port     the optional HTTP wrapper. bind must stay on loopback — reach it with
Tailscale or an SSH tunnel rather than opening a port to the internet.
autoTrust       when a repo may start without you approving it by hand. 'owner' is a repo
owned by the account you are signed in as; 'org' is one owned by an
organisation you belong to. Set either to false to approve those by hand too.
retentionDays   how long an idle worktree survives `skillhost reap`. Anything with
uncommitted or unpushed work is kept regardless of age.
bootstrapTimeoutSec  how long a repo's bootstrap may take before systemd gives up on the
session. It runs before Claude starts, so this is a ceiling on how long
`skillhost session` can sit there preparing.
